pages.name: 动画效果
pages.html: <main id="gallery"><button id="anim-fade-in" style="position:absolute;left:14px;top:12px;" data-animation="fade-in" data-animation-duration="1600" data-animation-easing="ease-in-out" data-animation-repeat="infinite" data-animation-distance="8">淡入</button><button id="anim-fade-out" style="position:absolute;left:126px;top:12px;" data-animation="fade-out" data-animation-duration="1600" data-animation-easing="ease-in-out" data-animation-repeat="infinite" data-animation-distance="8">淡出</button><button id="anim-slide-left" style="position:absolute;left:14px;top:60px;" data-animation="slide-left" data-animation-duration="1600" data-animation-easing="ease-in-out" data-animation-repeat="infinite" data-animation-distance="8">从左滑入</button><button id="anim-slide-right" style="position:absolute;left:126px;top:60px;" data-animation="slide-right" data-animation-duration="1600" data-animation-easing="ease-in-out" data-animation-repeat="infinite" data-animation-distance="8">从右滑入</button><button id="anim-slide-up" style="position:absolute;left:14px;top:108px;" data-animation="slide-up" data-animation-duration="1600" data-animation-easing="ease-in-out" data-animation-repeat="infinite" data-animation-distance="8">从下滑入</button><button id="anim-slide-down" style="position:absolute;left:126px;top:108px;" data-animation="slide-down" data-animation-duration="1600" data-animation-easing="ease-in-out" data-animation-repeat="infinite" data-animation-distance="8">从上滑入</button><button id="anim-float" style="position:absolute;left:14px;top:156px;" data-animation="float" data-animation-duration="1600" data-animation-easing="ease-in-out" data-animation-repeat="infinite" data-animation-distance="8">上下浮动</button><button id="anim-bounce" style="position:absolute;left:126px;top:156px;" data-animation="bounce" data-animation-duration="1600" data-animation-easing="ease-in-out" data-animation-repeat="infinite" data-animation-distance="8">弹跳</button><button id="anim-shake" style="position:absolute;left:14px;top:204px;" data-animation="shake" data-animation-duration="1600" data-animation-easing="ease-in-out" data-animation-repeat="infinite" data-animation-distance="8">左右抖动</button><button id="anim-pulse" style="position:absolute;left:126px;top:204px;" data-animation="pulse" data-animation-duration="1600" data-animation-easing="ease-in-out" data-animation-repeat="infinite" data-animation-distance="8">呼吸</button><button id="anim-blink" style="position:absolute;left:14px;top:252px;" data-animation="blink" data-animation-duration="1600" data-animation-easing="ease-in-out" data-animation-repeat="infinite" data-animation-distance="8">闪烁</button><button id="click-shake" style="position:absolute;left:126px;top:252px;" data-animation="shake" data-animation-duration="500" data-animation-trigger="click" data-animation-distance="8">点击抖动</button></main>
